convention: Seeded, honest resolution for LETHAL or CONTESTED non-combat checks (a running leap over a lethal drop, a hard climb, a forced save, a disarm) via `ops awen roll` — un-thumbable and hash-chained on the game-roll chain. The GM reads the relevant attribute and the telegraphed difficulty from the fiction BEFORE rolling; the die is only the luck. Resolves on the rulebook convention: effective score = attribute + situational intent (0..10) + roll, against a difficulty set by the telegraphed hardness; margin/12 sizes the result, read through the bands (fumble -> fail, crit -> clean success, hit -> success, graze -> success-at-a-cost, miss -> fail). The roll fixes the MAGNITUDE; the GM adjudicates the concrete outcome and its cost against the fiction. Scope contract (see gmContext policy resolution-scope): ROUTINE / low-stakes non-combat stays GM judgment (no roll); COMBAT is unchanged via `ops awen resolve`; the lethal-vs-routine lane is the GM's per-check judgment call, and once a check is lethal/contested the die resolves it. Loop-dark: rolls are the GM surface, never a client payload; the first result stands unless the fiction itself changed.
